channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio sabe importância de mulheres, diz Celina Leão
item.description: Celina Leão, DF candidate from PP, highlighted that Flávio Bolsonaro recognizes the importance of women and criticized Lula for comments about the touch test. The statements were made during a press interview at the National Congress.

item.title: Debates no segundo turno: datas, o que se sabe e o que falta definir sobre a participação de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed their participation in the second-round debates, scheduled between October 11 and 23. Both skipped debates in the first round. The runoff takes place on October 25, with Flávio leading in polls.

item.title: Celina Leão confirma apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro: "Consolidar os indecisos"
item.description: Celina Leão, governor of the Federal District, confirmed her support for Flávio Bolsonaro in the presidential runoff, emphasizing unifying undecided voters. She stated that party alignment will strengthen a potential Flávio government.

item.title: TSE nega fraude após pausa de 50 minutos na divulgação dos votos
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) clarified that the 50-minute interruption in publishing presidential election results was not due to fraud, but rather a 'data processing hold'. The stoppage occurred on Sunday, the 4th, temporarily affecting online vote tally updates without compromising the counting process.

item.title: “Vamos arregaçar com vagabundo”, diz Flávio ao lado de Caiado
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro announced, alongside Ronaldo Caiado, plans to adopt public security models from Goiás and São Paulo, vowing to crack down on homeless individuals. Caiado endorsed PL's candidacy for the runoff, citing 115% alignment in proposals, while Governors Tarcísio and Daniel Vilela attended the event.

item.title: Flávio diz que usará maioria no Senado e na Câmara para ‘mudar a Constituição’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated he will use the PL's congressional majority to push for constitutional changes following the 2026 election. He emphasized that his party will have the largest benches in both chambers, enabling progress on constitutional reforms. However, he did not specify what changes would be proposed.

item.title: OEA elogia processo eleitoral do Brasil, mas faz alertas para o 2º turno
item.description: The OAS praised the organization and transparency of Brazil's first round of elections, highlighting the absence of military in operations. However, it warned about the climate of polarization and misinformation that may affect the second round. The report recommends preserving the electoral system and greater legal security for candidates in the final dispute.

item.title: Lula e sua bolha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro leads the first round of the 2026 presidential election with 47.03% of valid votes, surpassing Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, who secured 45.16%. Bolsonaro's victory questions Lula's strategy and support in a challenging electoral scenario.

item.title: Lula admite que PT errou ao não se aproximar de frente ampla durante governo e pede ajuda a Alckmin
item.description: Lula admits the PT's mistake in not maintaining ties with the broad front after the 2022 elections and seeks Alckmin's support to recover votes lost to Flávio Bolsonaro, as the government attempts to rebuild links with center-right sectors and counter the opponent's image on social media.

item.title: Vice de Caiado, Kassab deve permanecer neutro na eleição presidencial
item.description: The national president of PSD, Gilberto Kassab, states he will not support Flávio Bolsonaro in the presidential election and will remain neutral. The party has freed its affiliates to support whomever is most convenient in the second round, maintaining impartiality. Kassab emphasized that in politics everything can change, but at this moment the trend is neutrality.

item.title: Derrotado, Ciro diz que Toffoli ‘foi o responsável pela fraude final’ contra sua campanha
item.description: Ciro Gomes, defeated in Ceará, accused the Supreme Court and particularly Minister Dias Toffoli of interference and authorizing illegal campaign advertising in favor of Elmano de Freitas and Luiz Inácio Lula, violating election law. He announced legal action to challenge the result and rejected Elmano's victory, calling the PT organization 'criminal'.

item.title: Câmara 'rejuvenesce', ganha mais mulheres, mas perfil médio do deputado se mantém; veja qual
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies recorded a record number of elected women, surpassing 100 for the first time, and welcomed the youngest deputy in history, Alvinho Lira (PP-AL), who will take office at 20 years old. However, the average profile of parliamentarians remains predominantly white married men with completed higher education and an average age of 49. The Black and Indigenous caucus decreased, while the number of elected white representatives increased.

item.title: Lavareda nega 'revolução de direita’, vê margem estreita e aponta 3 frentes para Lula vencer Flávio
item.description: Political scientist Antonio Lavareda argues that Flávio Bolsonaro's first-round win over Lula does not signal a right-wing revolution, but rather minor electoral shifts and high abstention. He identifies three key fronts for Lula to reverse the result: recovering abstinent voters, winning over eliminated candidates' supporters, and attracting some Flávio voters.

item.title: União-PP oficializa apoio a Flávio e marca ato para esta quarta
item.description: The União Progressista federation, composed of PP and União Brasil, officially endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) for the presidential runoff, scheduling an event for Wednesday in Brasília.

item.title: PGR é a favor do pedido de Jair Bolsonaro para ver Flávio após 1º turno
item.description: The PGR, led by Paulo Gonet, agreed to Jair Bolsonaro's request to receive visits from his son Flávio after the first round of elections, removing obstacles to the petition filed with Alexandre de Moraes. The extension of the visit restriction had been decided in July 2026, following Flávio's release of a letter supporting his father's candidacy.

item.title: PGR defende que Flávio possa voltar a visitar Jair Bolsonaro na prisão domiciliar
item.description: The Attorney General's Office supports Senator Flávio Bolsonaro visiting his father, Jair Bolsonaro, under house arrest. The position was taken after a minister consulted the Public Ministry on the request. Flávio is a presidential candidate for the PL party.

item.title: Lula é aconselhado por governadores a endurecer tom sobre segurança e falar mais diretamente em prisão de bandido
item.description: State governors advise Lula to adopt a stricter stance on public security in the final stretch of the campaign, prioritizing direct speeches that promise crackdowns and imprisonment of criminals instead of technical debates on the Public Security PEC.

item.title: Flávio recebe coro por Caiado ministro, mas evita confirmar ex-governador em eventual governo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro received support from Ronaldo Caiado in Goiânia, but avoided confirming a ministry for the former governor, emphasizing convergence on public security and promising 500,000 prison spots.

item.title: Gilmar Mendes arquiva denúncia contra vice de Flávio por suposto estupro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes closed the investigation against Alfredo Gaspar, running mate of Flávio Bolsonaro, on suspicion of rape. The decision was confirmed after reviewing the complaint filed by the Federal Police.

item.title: PGR dá aval para Bolsonaro receber visita de Flávio antes do fim de restrição imposta por Moraes
item.description: The Brazilian Attorney General's Office authorized former President Jair Bolsonaro, under house arrest, to resume visits from his son Flávio Bolsonaro before the restriction imposed by Minister Alexandre de Moraes expires. Attorney General Paulo Gonet stated there are no new facts justifying the extension of the measure, agreeing with the defense's request. It now falls to the Supreme Court to decide whether to restore the ordinary visiting regime or only allow an exceptional family meeting.

item.title: O movimento de Michelle Bolsonaro que pode mexer com a campanha de Flávio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro, newly elected senator from the Federal District, is expected to increase her presence in Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, particularly in strategic areas like Amazonas, where she will support PL candidate Professor Maria do Carmo. The strategy aims to strengthen the party's evangelical and female base after a public reconciliation. Her strong electoral performance positions her as a key figure to mobilize voters in regional campaigns.

item.title: Urna eletrônica: a grande vencedora das eleições 2026
item.description: Following the first round of the 2026 elections, the article emphasizes that the Brazilian electronic voting machine remains a cornerstone of democracy, though it requires continuous improvements in technology and logistics. As an electoral prosecutor, the author points out operational issues such as biometric reading failures on rainy days, overcrowded polling stations, and inadequate facilities, while clarifying these do not indicate fraud. He stresses the need to investigate any anomalies based on concrete evidence rather than unfounded suspicions.

item.title: Vai ter segundo turno? Por que Garotinho é decisivo? Quando haverá definição? Veja perguntas e respostas sobre impasse no Rio
item.description: The state of Rio de Janeiro still does not know whether there will be a runoff election for governor after the 2026 vote, due to a dispute over the 274,400 voters of Anthony Garotinho, whose ballots may or may not be counted. Douglas Ruas (PL) leads with 49.2% of valid votes versus 42.7% for Eduardo Paes (PSD), and a TSE ruling could confirm Ruas' victory in the first round.

item.title: PGR concorda com visita de Flávio Bolsonaro ao pai; pedido foi feito pela defesa após primeiro turno
item.description: The PGR agreed to Flávio Bolsonaro visiting his father, Jair Bolsonaro, following a request from the defense. The plea was submitted to the STF, which is evaluating the restoration of normal visitation rules suspended for 90 days after Jair violated social media restrictions.

item.title: PGR dá parecer favorável à retomada das visitas de Flávio a Bolsonaro
item.description: The Federal Prosecution Service (PGR) approved the request from Jair Bolsonaro's defense to resume visits by Flávio Bolsonaro to the former president's home detention. The favorable opinion was issued based on no new facts indicating non-compliance with the conditions set for the provisional release.

item.title: Gusttavo Lima terá que pagar indenização a fã expulsa de show por manifestação política
item.description: A court in Piauí ordered Gusttavo Lima and the Marina Park Hotel to pay R$ 5,000 in moral damages to Virginia Nogueira, who was ejected from a Fortaleza concert after making a pro-Lula gesture. The singer claimed she threw bottles at the stage, but the judge ruled that the viral social media backlash worsened her distress.

item.title: Após decisão de Moraes, Oswaldo Eustáquio diz que prepara volta ao Brasil
item.description: Journalist Oswaldo Eustáquio, who has been in Spain since 2023, said he plans to return to Brazil after the investigation led by Supreme Court minister Alexandre de Moraes was archived. His return will only happen if Flávio Bolsonaro is elected president.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro recebe apoio de Caiado e promete aprovar redução da maioridade e castração química
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) secured support from Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) for the runoff, promising increased funding for Goiás and adopting Caiado's public security model at the federal level. Key proposals include lowering the age of criminal responsibility and chemical castration for pedophiles and rapists, backed by the newly elected right-wing caucus in Congress.

item.title: Celina Leão critica Eduarda Campopiano por negar existência do feminicídio
item.description: Federal District Governor Celina Leão (PP) criticized São Paulo state representative-elect Eduarda Campopiano (PL) for denying the existence of femicide, following the União Progressista federation's announcement of support for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the runoff. The incident highlighted internal tensions among party alliances and divergences over gender policies.

item.title: União Progressista oficializa apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º turno
item.description: The União Progressista coalition, composed of União and PP, officially announced its support for Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round on October 6th, after remaining neutral in the first round. The decision was announced during a congressional meeting attended by Senator Tereza Cristina and other party leaders.

item.title: É preciso dialogar com quem votou em Cury e Renan, dizem sindicatos
item.description: Unions call for dialogue with voters of Cury, Renan, and Flávio, stressing the importance of voting for Lula in the second round to advance workers' agendas.

item.title: Vice de Flávio reage ao arquivamento de investigação por Gilmar Mendes
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes ordered the closure of an investigation into alleged rape involving lawmaker Alfredo Gaspar, running mate of Flávio Bolsonaro, after the Public Ministry found no evidence. Gaspar called the accusation an 'injustice' and 'slanderous complaint.' The probe was initiated following a report by Lindbergh Farias and Soraya Thronicke.

item.title: Podemos conversa com Flávio e reunirá eleitos para definir apoio
item.description: The Podemos party scheduled a meeting in Brasília to discuss support for Flávio Bolsonaro in the presidential runoff. Party president Renata Abreu met with Flávio, Tarcísio de Freitas, and Rogério Marinho. The party, which expanded its representation, is expected to define its strategic position for the election.

item.title: Campanha de Lula sobre força da direita no mundo: O vento sopra contra nós
item.description: Lula's campaign analyzes the first round of elections in light of a global trend toward strengthening the right. Flávio Bolsonaro is viewed as part of an international scenario where conservative parties achieve good electoral results.

item.title: Por que PSOL deixou de fazer 6 deputados apesar de recorde de Erika Hilton
item.description: Despite Erika Hilton's record 1.58 million votes, PSOL lost six seats in the Chamber of Deputies. The gap between her individual success and the party's overall weak performance, combined with strategic errors and over-reliance on a single candidate, explains the reduced representation. Political polarization and economic concerns also drove voter fragmentation.

item.title: Lula recebe governadores do PI, da BA e do CE no Alvorada
item.description: President Lula met with re-elected governors at Palácio da Alvorada: Rafael Fonteles (Piauí), Elmano de Freitas (Ceará), and Jerônimo Rodrigues (Bahia), all from the PT party. Their re-election in the first round strengthens the petivist base supporting Lula's re-election campaign heading toward the 2026 elections.

item.title: Deltan diz que pauta mais urgente é tirar Lula do poder
item.description: Deltan Dallagnol expressed support for Flávio Bolsonaro and stated that the main opposition priority is preventing Lula's reelection. He viewed the first-round results as a positive signal for the anti-PT campaign.

item.title: Flávio diz que negocia com Republicanos e Tarcísio articula apoio
item.description: Presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) began negotiations with the Republicanos to broaden support in the second round, with São Paulo governor Tarcísio de Freitas leading the alliance. He thanked Romeu Zema (Novo) for support and announced a stop in Goiânia to receive Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), with convergence on security, health, AI, and mining.

item.title: Cartilha orienta apoiadores de Paes a descolar de Lula no segundo turno
item.description: Eduardo Paes' (PSD) campaign distributes a pamphlet advising supporters to avoid national polarization between Lula and Bolsonaro, suggesting that votes for governor and president can differ. The strategy aims to attract undecided voters and broaden support in the second round, especially given the strong Bolsonarist presence in the state.

item.title: “O Supremo precisa deixar de ser uma delegacia de polícia”
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho, campaign coordinator for Flávio Bolsonaro, criticized the STF for viewing judicial actions and public threats from ministers as a 'police delegation,' referencing a Globo report. He argued for the judiciary's independence without interfering in the electoral process.

item.title: Flávio mira 33 milhões de abstencionistas no 2º turno
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, presidential candidate from PL, stated he aims to reach the 33 million voters who abstained in the first round. He emphasized that many voters stayed away due to disappointment with politics and sees these non-voters as a base to expand his electoral support in the second round. His strategy focuses on engaging new voters dissatisfied with the current political system.

item.title: Lula almoça com petistas do Nordeste e se prepara para sabatina do JN
item.description: Lula meets with Northeast PT leaders and prepares for a Jornal Nacional interview, defining strategies for the runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro. Meetings at Alvorada Palace include governors and senators, focusing on debates and a regionally targeted schedule.

item.title: Após eleição, Augusto Cury tenta transformar seu plano de governo em novo best-seller
item.description: After securing third place in the presidential race, Augusto Cury launches the book 'O Brasil dos Nossos Sonhos', compiling his government plan submitted by Avante. The work includes proposals such as ending presidential re-election, eight-year terms for Supreme Court justices, and converting high school into technical education, though its campaign connection sparked internal criticism within the party.

item.title: Flávio critica PEC da 6x1 e volta a defender regime por hora: "Liberdade"
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) criticized the government's PEC to reduce the workday and advocated an alternative proposal allowing workers to negotiate their own hours, prioritizing freedom and flexibility. He also proposed private nursery vouchers for mothers needing to balance work and childcare.

item.title: Rogério Marinho diz que ‘Supremo precisa deixar de ser uma delegacia de polícia’
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho criticized the STF's performance, calling it a 'police station' and advocating for a Judiciary reform so the court focuses solely on constitutional jurisdiction. He accuses justices of using the press and investigations to oversee Congress, hindering parliamentary activity.

item.title: ‘Império em Transe’ recebe Vera Chaia e Cláudio Couto para debater a interferência dos EUA no Brasil
item.description: The 'Império em Transe' cycle examines U.S. interference in the Brazilian election, analyzing tariffs and sovereignty pressures. Vera Chaia and Cláudio Couto discuss the geopolitical implications for the vote.

item.title: Os eleitos/Filipe Barros: ‘Precisamos rediscutir qual Supremo Tribunal Federal nós queremos'
item.description: Filipe Barros, elected senator from Paraná, advocates for a broad reform of the STF, including term limits for justices and impeachment of those accused of abuses. He highlights the judiciary's credibility crisis as an electoral factor and supports measures such as banning betting markets and ending the 6x1 scale.

item.title: Candidata do PL tem mais votos que 2 eleitos da esquerda, mas fica de fora
item.description: Mariana Naime (PL) missed out on a seat in the Chamber of Deputies despite receiving 67,218 votes, more than the elected Agnelo Queiroz (PT) and Professor Reginaldo Veras (PV). The proportional system distributes seats based on the party's overall performance.

item.title: Segurança pública une Flávio Bolsonaro e Ronaldo Caiado
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro and Ronaldo Caiado met in Goiânia to seal support for the second round, with Caiado possibly joining as Public Security minister. The 'AI Against Crime' program in Goiás stands out for high arrest rates and reduced violence.

item.title: Moraes pede parecer da PGR sobre visita de Flávio ao pai
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes ordered the Attorney General's Office to issue an opinion on Flávio Bolsonaro's request to visit his father, Jair Bolsonaro, under house arrest. The defense requested the end of restrictions imposed in July 2026, arguing no new facts justify maintaining the ban. The restriction period ends on October 11, two weeks before the election runoff.
